jobs.description:
About Us ... Soho House Amsterdam is an integral part of a global community dedicated to creative individuals, providing a welcoming environment to work, relax, and connect. Recently awarded with a Michelin Key, our establishment is recognized for its exceptional comfort and design. We invite you to join our team and contribute to delivering thoughtful, high-quality experiences for our esteemed members and guests.The RoleWe're currently looking for an enthusiastic Bar Back to join our bar team. In this role, you'll support the bartenders by preparing mise en place, keeping the bar fully stocked and organised, polishing glassware, and assisting with general cleaning duties.This is a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience and start or grow your career in the bar and hospitality world.What We're Looking For
• A positive, collaborative team player with strong communication skills
• Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays
• A genuine interest in food, beverage, and hospitality
• Previous experience is a plus, but not required
• A good level of English (additional languages are a bonus)📍 Amsterdam | Flexible hours  Interested? Apply and start your journey with Soho House. Benefits Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that include global benefits and perks. Whether you are seeking entry-level employment or a new opportunity to advance your career, we provide training to develop the technical and managerial skills necessary for your professional growth.
• Salary in line with Horeca CAO (no your salary under 20y/o)
• Travel allowance for distances exceeding 7.5 km
• Healthy team meals provided during your shift
• Soho Friends Membership & partners discount
• 50% F&B discount 
• In-house experience opportunities upon contract completion 
• Refer a star and you could be eligible to receive a €300 bonus
